cells.gaps: No source found of a transfer going without the authority's authorisation under the 2004 law, or of a ratification of the Malabo Convention.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): Articles 50 to 52 of Organic Law 2004-63 allow transfer only to an adequate country and require prior authorisation of the authority in every case [TUN-001], so the rule is protected but closed and the stage is 2. A 2025 bill with a revised framework [TUN-004] is not in force.
